lead: An array type takes one parameter, so `array<string, uint>` does not parse.
body: The key type is never written — a string-keyed array of counts is `array<uint>` and the literal supplies the keys — so the comma is read as call syntax and what comes back is an `E0101`/`E0102` pair pointing at the `<`, saying nothing about types. Declare the value type alone and key the literal: `array<uint> $seen = ["get" => 0];`.
